apps.name: Beacon Finance
apps.whats_new:
48.21.2  (November 2026)  THE CHURCH FINANCE EDITION IS REMOVED
  - The Church Finance Edition (the same program for other churches, with a blank book and a setup wizard) is no longer
    made: make_church_edition.py, build_church_edition.bat, build_mac_apps.sh, CHURCH_EDITION_GUIDE.txt, the setup wizard
    and every "if this is the Church Edition" step in the program are gone. Beacon's books never used them; nothing you see
    or do changes. Build the Mac app with  bash build_mac_app.sh.
  - This program's own copy of the giving page (giving_page/) and the code that made the giving page files are gone too:
    Beacon Pastor → Publish Everything makes and publishes the giving page.

apps.name: Beacon Secretary
apps.whats_new:
v4.43.4 - LINK AN IMPORTED BAPTISM OR DEDICATION TO A MEMBER
  - Import from Excel: in the list shown before importing, choose a person and click Link to a member… (or double-click
    them) to choose who they are in the members list, or Not a member. Useful when two members have the same name, or the
    name in the workbook is written differently. The member's profile takes the date.
  - Baptism & Dedication: Link to a member… links a record already there (an imported one, say) to a member.

apps.name: Beacon Admin
apps.whats_new: NEW IN 1.31.1: CLEARER SIGN-IN, LESS UNUSED CODE - A wrong email or password now says "The email or password is not correct." (it showed Firebase's own code). Parts nobody used were removed (members' sign-in accounts, which only Beacon Secretary makes; two unused schedule queries; unused scrolling helpers and imports). Nothing else changed.

apps.name: Beacon Worship & Media
apps.whats_new: NEW IN 1.1.2: GOOGLE DRIVE WORKS ON WINDOWS - The Windows setup of 1.1.1 did not bring the Google Drive libraries, so Online & Sharing → 5. More than one computer said "Could not connect to Google Drive. The Google Drive libraries are not installed." This setup brings them (Google's API client and sign-in). Install it over 1.1.1: your songs, set lists and the sign-in stay. The program itself did not change (the Mac app 1.1.1 already had them).
